title: The $1000 betrayal that haunted Niko Bellic in GTA 4
subject: niko
description:
Would you have killed Darko or let him live? 👇

The truth about the ambush that killed Niko Bellic's unit, and the man who sold them out. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto IV.

scenes.text: Twelve of Niko Bellic's comrades died for one thousand dollars.
Their unit was ambushed during the Yugoslav Wars. Only three walked away: Niko, Florian Cravic and Darko Brevic.
For years, Niko carried one question: which of them talked?
In Liberty City he found Florian, now calling himself Bernie Crane, and learned he was innocent.
But that's not the worst part. Darko was flown to the city, a broken addict who admitted everything.
He had given away their position for heroin money.
